assessments.affected_upstream_capability: Unauthenticated collection-create endpoint can load a remote repository with trust_remote_code.
assessments.impact_statement: Only an embedded RustBindingsAPI persistent index is constructed, with operator-supplied bounded embeddings and no Chroma HTTP server, tenant API, SimpleRBAC provider or attacker-controlled embedding configuration. Explicit client settings override remote/server environment selection. Java performs authorization before internal index work. This assessment does not fix the upstream library and ceases to apply if the entrypoint, client settings or source bindings change.
